intelligence.enrichment: Light travels in a straight line, so a flame or spot is seen when the path is straight and aligned, and is not seen when the path is bent or misaligned. A straight, aligned path lets light reach the eye or screen; a bent or misaligned path prevents that light from reaching it. The learner correctly applies this rule: Light travels in a straight line, so a flame or spot is seen when the path is straight and aligned, and is not seen when the path is bent or misaligned. A bright light can find its way through any opening or curved path if the source is strong enough.
